title: Demasiado largo (> 512 tokens)
defects: detalle secundario antes que la pose
prompt: A detailed full-body illustration of two adventurers resting at a mountain pass. The first is a broad-shouldered woman in her forties with weathered olive skin, a strong jaw, a thin scar crossing her left eyebrow, deep-set hazel eyes and thick dark eyebrows. Her black hair is shaved on the sides and gathered on top into a short braided crest held by a copper ring. She wears a sleeveless quilted gambeson in faded crimson, laced at the sides with leather cords, over a long-sleeved linen undershirt rolled to the elbows. Her forearms are wrapped in stained cloth bandages and she has a small tattoo of three dots on the back of her right hand. A wide leather belt with a brass buckle carries a pouch, a coiled rope, a waterskin and a short curved knife in a worn sheath. Her trousers are dark brown wool, tucked into knee-high boots with reinforced toes and scuffed heels. Over her shoulders hangs a heavy grey wool cloak with a fur-lined collar, pinned at the chest with an iron brooch shaped like a wolf head. The second adventurer is a slender young man with pale freckled skin, a narrow face, large grey eyes, a slightly crooked nose and messy shoulder-length copper hair tied loosely at the nape. He wears round wire-rimmed spectacles, a dark green hooded tunic with embroidered silver vines along the hem and cuffs, fingerless leather gloves, a satchel crossed over his chest stuffed with rolled maps and quills, slim grey trousers and soft ankle boots. A small brass compass hangs from a chain around his neck. In the background, jagged snowy peaks rise under a pale sky with drifting clouds, a narrow stone path winds down into a valley of dark pine forests, a crumbling watchtower stands on a distant ridge, and a few ravens circle overhead. The light is cold and clear, late afternoon, with long blue shadows on the snow and a warm glow on the edges of the clouds. The woman sits on a flat boulder with her legs apart, elbows resting on her knees, holding the waterskin in both hands, while the man stands beside her leaning on a wooden staff, one hand on her shoulder, pointing toward the valley with the other and smiling.
